Hi Anna — thanks for sending these over and for the clear note on payment preferences. Quick checklist from our side:

- Confirm legal entity match on W-9 (we'll validate EIN against legal name).
- We need a bank letter or voided check for ACH verification if you want direct ACH to corporate account (bank_confirmation.csv helps but we typically require the letter for first-time > $10k).
- If you want to map invoices conditionally to BillTrust for payments < $10k, we can set a secondary payee routing; need a short PO-routing policy doc or confirmation on who should approve that mapping in your system.
- Tax and compliance will run a quick identity check; expect a SOC2/data handling questionnaire if you plan to store or process any Redwood data.

Cc'ing Kim and Jordan to confirm: Kim, can AP create a dual-route profile (BillTrust intermediary + corporate ACH) and record the alternate payment preference on the vendor master? Jordan, will you own the legal-entity verification and final entity name canonicalization?

I'll move the attachments into our onboarding bucket. If possible, Anna, please reply with a one-line confirmation of who in your finance team signs off on the BillTrust routing (name + title).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
